conceptZh: 玩具戰士打開禮物盒，蟲一隻一隻彈出來，嚇他一跳，又一起排成蟲字。
object: a chunky toy warrior and a surprise gift box
morph: three small caterpillar toys pop out and settle as 蟲
creativeAngle: 驚喜彈出：蟲蟲們從盒子彈出，連戰士都愣住。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale leaf-green background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 蟲 as the only text on screen, drawn in bright magenta-pink solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a chunky toy warrior with a foam sword and round shield swaggers up to a polka-dot gift box and raps on it; the first 蟲 is spoken as the lid wobbles and the top 中 stroke pokes out. 1.7-3.4s: the lid bursts and three tiny stripe caterpillar toys spring out like jack-in-the-box; the warrior does a big double-take, shield flying; the second 蟲 is spoken as the caterpillars crawl into the lower 虫 strokes. 3.4-5s: 昆蟲 is spoken as a toy ladybug and a firefly buzz up out of the box one after the other. 5-8s: hold; the warrior bows his foam sword to the bugs, glyph still. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "蟲、蟲、昆蟲" (ㄔㄨㄥˊ、ㄔㄨㄥˊ、ㄎㄨㄣ ㄔㄨㄥˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 蟲 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.

conceptZh: 迴力賽車想衝去撞那片大葉子，第一次衝過頭撲空，第二次用力拉回來再衝，咚一聲撞上樹樁，躲在葉子下的三隻紅色小蟲被震飛，一隻落在上、兩隻落在下，咔咔咔排成蟲字，賽車壓扁了還傻笑，最後一隻黃色毛毛蟲叼著葉子從它背後冒出來。
object: a squeaky pull-back toy race car with googly eyes, plus a big green leaf on a stubby wooden stump hiding three red rubber bugs; a fuzzy yellow caterpillar for the payoff
morph: the nose-first crash shakes three red rubber bugs off the leaf; they tumble in the air and curl into the component 虫 three times, one landing on top and two side by side below, locking into the glyph 蟲 in solid magenta
creativeAngle: 沿用「衝鋒撞擊」模式但完全換掉上一版的禮物盒／戰士：這次主角是永遠衝過頭的迴力賽車，先用一次撲空建立「衝過頭」個性，再用更大的拉回蓄力製造期待，撞擊本身直接把三隻躲著的小蟲震成「一上二下」的蟲字結構，字形由撞擊產生而非自己飄出來。詞選最安全的毛毛蟲，由一隻真的毛毛蟲叼著那片葉子登場呼應，和畫面完全對應。
promptEn:
An 8-second bright cartoon clip on a soft pale cream background, flat and uncluttered. The only text ever on screen is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 蟲, formed in thick solid magenta strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with clear margins.

Lead: a squeaky pull-back toy race car, glossy orange with a white racing stripe, huge wobbly googly eyes and a chrome grin. It always overshoots and crashes nose first.

0–1.5s: the car sits at far left. At center stands a stubby wooden stump with a giant shiny green leaf lying on top. The car's googly eyes spin and lock onto the leaf, it rears back on its rear wheels, front wheels scrabbling with a tiny squeak, clearly wanting to ram that leaf.

1.5–3s: it zips across the frame, way too fast, sails right past the stump without touching it, screeches to a halt at the far right edge in a little puff of dust, eyes rolling in opposite directions. It reverses back to the left with a sheepish wiggle. The first "蟲" is spoken here, as the car plants itself and drags backward in a huge rubber-band wind-up, body stretched long, wheels squealing, a frozen half-second of anticipation.

3–4.5s: it releases and charges straight at the stump, BONK, nose first, squashing flat as a pancake. The stump and leaf flip up and tumble off the right edge, and three red rubber bugs that were hiding under the leaf pop into the air, legs wiggling. They drop with three clicks and curl into shape: one lands on top as 虫, two land side by side below as 虫虫, locking together into the correct glyph 蟲, centered. The second "蟲" is spoken exactly as the three bugs click into place.

4.5–5s: the car un-squashes with a boing, wobbles out to the bottom-left corner on bent wheels, dizzy spiral eyes and a goofy grin, little stars circling its antenna.

5–8s: the finished 蟲 holds perfectly still and readable in the center for the full final 3 seconds. At about 5.5s the word "毛毛蟲" is spoken as a fuzzy yellow caterpillar pokes up from behind the dizzy car, wearing the big green leaf like a hat and chewing a bite out of it, wiggling in time with the word. The car's eyes recenter, it does a happy little bounce and the caterpillar pats its hood. Nothing touches or covers the strokes.

Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "蟲、蟲、毛毛蟲" (ㄔㄨㄥˊ、ㄔㄨㄥˊ、ㄇㄠˊ ㄇㄠˊ ㄔㄨㄥˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word. No other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Only soft squeaks, a cartoon bonk and gentle boings, all quieter than the voice. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
